description: Small real ToolSandbox bring-up seed for observation-spoofing overlay planning. This manifest probe enumerates real scenario metadata and milestone oracles but does not run a model and is not a representative 10-15% benchmark slice.
paper_grade_next_step: Convert this manifest-only bring-up seed into an executable overlay run where ToolSandbox returns are intercepted for the model, while the original execution context and milestone evaluator remain authoritative. A representative 10-15% ToolSandbox slice must be stratified separately and will require far more than 12 tasks.
